run_dlrm_data_preprocessing: run the Criteo dataset preprocessing CLI with --data-set kaggle --raw-data-file path/to/train.txt
getCriteoAdData: create a function to preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte ad data into NPZ files with categorical encoding
loadDataset: load and preprocess the Criteo kaggle or terabyte dataset with optional memory mapping and subsampling
transformCriteoAdData: transform Criteo ad data by applying log transformation on dense features and splitting into train val test sets
convertUStringToDistinctIntsDict: convert a matrix of unicode strings into distinct integers using per-column dictionaries and category counts
